mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_logs (post_id, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{postId}, #{ip}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start}), 0) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at >= #{start} THEN ip END) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at >= #{start} THEN post_id END) AS post_count, COALESCE(SUM(created_at < #{start}), 0) AS prev_pv FROM visit_logs WHERE created_at >= #{prevStart} AND created_at < #{end}

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(v.created_at, '%H') DATE_FORMAT(v.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM visit_logs v WHERE GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT v.post_id AS post_id, p.title AS title, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM visit_logs v LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.post_id WHERE GROUP BY v.post_id, p.title ORDER BY visit_count DESC, v.post_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT v.ip AS ip, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM visit_logs v WHERE GROUP BY v.ip ORDER BY visit_count DESC, v.ip ASC

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM visit_logs v LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.post_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY visit_count DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.id AS id, v.created_at AS created_at, v.post_id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, v.ip AS ip, v.user_agent AS user_agent FROM visit_logs v LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.post_id WHERE AND v.post_id = #{postId} AND v.ip LIKE #{ipPattern} ESCAPE '\\'
AND v.user_agent LIKE CONCAT('%', , '%') ESCAPE '\\'
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
